# Croslin Law, PLLC

> Tulsa, Oklahoma law firm. Brayden Croslin, founding attorney, focuses on family law. The firm also helps clients with wills and trusts, probate, asset protection, criminal defense, expungements, and protective orders.

Phone: (405) 397-8313
Email: brayden@croslin.law

Hours: Monday to Thursday 8 to 5, Friday 8 to 12
Counties served: Tulsa, Creek, Osage, Rogers, Wagoner, Washington, Okmulgee, Muskogee, Pawnee, Mayes, Nowata, Cherokee, and Kay

This website provides general information and is not legal advice. Using it or contacting the firm does not create an attorney-client relationship. See the Legal Disclaimer.

## Practice areas
- [Divorce](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/divorce/): Tulsa divorce attorney. Explore your options, negotiate settlements, divide property and debts, and take your case to trial when needed.
- [Custody and Visitation](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/custody-and-visitation/): Tulsa custody and visitation attorney. Help with custody, visitation, relocation, enforcement, and modifications in Tulsa and surrounding counties.
- [Child Support](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/child-support/): Tulsa child support attorney for parents paying or receiving support: calculations, modifications, arrears, and enforcement.
- [Guardianship](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/guardianship/): Tulsa guardianship attorney for children and incapacitated adults. We help you seek a guardianship or respond to one.
- [Adoption](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/adoption/): Tulsa adoption attorney helping with stepparent, private, and contested adoptions, and adoptions involving tribal membership.
- [Prenuptial Agreements](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/prenuptial-agreements/): Tulsa prenup attorney. We help you review, draft, and negotiate a prenup before you marry.
- [Grandparents Rights](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/grandparents-rights/): Tulsa attorney for grandparent visitation and guardianship. Learn what Oklahoma law allows and how to ask a court for visitation.
- [Wills and Trusts](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/estate-planning/): Tulsa wills and trusts attorney. Plan before your family needs it with a will, a trust, and a plan that fits your life.
- [Probate](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/probate/): Tulsa probate attorney helping executors and families open an estate, notify creditors, and close the estate.
- [Asset Protection](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/asset-protection/): Tulsa asset protection attorney. Understand trusts, business entities, and fraudulent transfer risks, and plan before problems arise.
- [Criminal Defense](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/criminal-defense/): Tulsa criminal defense attorney. Get help with bond, hearings, evidence, negotiations, and trial after an arrest or charge.
- [Expungements](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/expungements/): Oklahoma expungement attorney in Tulsa. Find out whether your record qualifies, and get help filing and attending the hearing.
- [Protective Orders](https://croslinlawoffice.com/practice/protective-orders/): Tulsa protective order attorney for people seeking a protective order and people responding to one.
